key_control_implementation.scope: Source-inspected branch plus exact command/control/seed receipts; not a fresh RF or raw I/Q replay.

limitations: Every lower and upper endpoint is separately pointwise one-sided 95%; together they are not a joint 95% confidence interval. No simultaneous guarantee across cells, gates, targets or adaptive development selections.

Bounds describe the equal-bit-population mean with independent iid Bernoulli outcomes within each bit stratum; p0 may differ from p1. Distinct pseudorandom roots support the simulation design, not real-world or PRNG independence proof.

All-success equal-stratum lower and all-failure upper endpoints use AM-GM; other endpoints average per-bit one-sided 97.5% Clopper-Pearson bounds (Bonferroni). No pooled common-p binomial assumption is made.

Followup points were selected prospectively using earlier results, and these new indices are disjoint. This does not make a comparison to differently seeded rate/CN0 populations a paired intervention.

Wrong-key signal admissions are material key-discrimination failures despite zero null admissions. They do not by themselves contradict the Gaussian noise-only analytical gate, and prevent a generic successful reception/rejection claim for these slower-rate settings.

Null/wrong-key controls share the first32 source/root cases with their signal cell. They are distinct control distributions, not additional independent signal paths, independent exposure duration or empirical daily false-admission proof.
Metadata-only raw verification status remains explicit; archive collector/full raw-array integrity audit is separate.

runtime_binding_audit.scope: Accepted full runtime/source/manifest/score binding audit; this reviewer additionally checked all saved score arrays and 1628 actual manifest hash/seed/embedded command bindings. Omitted raw arrays were not independently rehashed here.

wrong_key_pair_identity_checks.interpretation: Same source/channel/noise roots and observed total energies/calendar, changed public basis/projections. Hash equality of energies alone does not prove full raw I/Q identity.
